hypothesis: With fixed local chemistry, a parent sequence A versus B might change the relative occurrence of newly assembled, particle-disjoint A/B four-atom chains nearby beyond changes in total reaction opportunities. A signal may be geometric/species-accessibility, NOT proven inheritance.
epistemic_status: Prospective probe of a deliberately assembled nonreplicating initial scaffold; not natural origin of replication; no inference of genotype/organism.

model.physical_laws: unchanged original M6 unfed-6101 chemistry, movement, energy, species and RNG code
model.bonded_fixture_energy: 3 bonds each require 2 energy units from each endpoint and 1 dissipation from each endpoint; each bond stores 4 units, ledger dissipated starts at 6. No-bond fixtures have zero initial dissipation, a documented control confound.
model.background_placement: 196 non-scaffold particles sampled without replacement from free cells with RNG(seed), exactly one raw uint64 per placed particle; same positions, species and post-placement RNG state in all arms of one seed.
model.background_species_order: 78 S0 then 78 S1 then 24 S2 then 16 S3; S0/S1 scaffold each 2, total species counts stay fixed.
model.variant_signatures: computed with original alife.structures.signature() from fixture at tick 0; canonical exact tree for four nodes
model.no_external_copying: prohibited; initial scaffold is manually synthesized once, without forcing offspring

measurements.primary: Count each new material set of four non-scaffold particle IDs with an exact A or B tree signature upon first detection, at a position within toroidal Manhattan distance <=2 of the four initial scaffold sites. Report counts split by whether any candidate constituent ever shared an aggregate with scaffold beforehand.
secondary: Total disjoint-from-scaffold newly observed A/B signatures anywhere (distinct material-ID sets per signature)
All size-four tree appearances of either variant, including number previously material-connected to scaffold
Initial scaffold chemistry integrity and lifetime
Free non-scaffold particles within one cell of any fixed scaffold site, accumulated over time
Global bond formation and break totals
Run end full state hash, energy ledger, config hash, RNG draws/fingerprint
measurements.unique_event_key: (variant_signature, sorted four particle IDs) across a run; one count per such pair, not per persistence tick
measurements.ancestry_rule: Any historical common bonded component with scaffold particles flags a material connection, and strict events exclude those flagged; geometric proximity alone is not causal evidence.
measurements.exclusions: Do not count any aggregate containing scaffold particle IDs; do not infer generation from tracker continuity or shared species.

comparison.paired_seed: Compare A/B and orientation-reversed arms within identical seeded background positions, never assume identical RNG trajectories after divergence.
comparison.specificity_contrasts: For each arm, compare counts of A vs B among strict near-scaffold daughter structures; reverse orientations should agree in direction. Compare no-bond fixture arms to estimate background and kinetic confounding.
comparison.minimum_signal_for_followup: At least 5 strict near-scaffold A/B occurrences total across each of A, B, A_reverse, B_reverse (not just counts of existing template) AND positive within-arm variant preference in both orientations across at least 8 of 12 seeds each. Otherwise declare underpowered/no signal in this screen.
comparison.decision_rule: Regardless of screen result, no causal replication or heredity claim. Strong signal triggers new preregistered independent multi-seed causal validation, not physics change; null result is absence of observed specificity at tested fixture/300 ticks, not an impossibility proof.
comparison.no_p_hacking: No adaptively adjusted seeds, sample size, arm order, duration, size, density, radius, success window, signatures, or kinetic rates after results.
comparison.data_output: Machine-readable per-seed/per-arm metrics with all zero runs, canonical signatures, config SHA, world hash and full raw RNG accounting.
comparison.stop_on_failure: Any broken initial constraint, nondeterministic replay, energy/bond/occupancy invariant, signature equivalence, or fixture mismatch fails CI and prevents scientific conclusion.

historical_safety.do_not_modify: src/, existing configs, existing campaign manifests/results, preregistered detectors, SPEC.md, M6 hashes
